High-level asks:
- 1 full day (4 blocks): executive strategy (2h), product deep-dive (1.5h), breakouts (1h), board prep (30m)
- Follow-on board Q&A (90m) scheduled to accommodate SG attendees (early morning PT = late evening SG)

Attached is an initial attendee list and roles. Can you propose a schedule that minimizes disruption to the APAC team while keeping two core US execs present? Also confirm capacity and AV for a hybrid board Q&A.

Warmly,

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the detail and the attendee list. Quick notes and two proposed rhythms below.

Option A — Onsite (San Diego) hybrid handoff
- 08:30–10:30 PT: Executive strategy (US West on site + remote APAC joins for first 30 mins for alignment)
- 11:00–12:30 PT: Product deep-dive (recorded for SG)
- 13:30–14:30 PT: Breakouts (parallel rooms; breakout leads will bridge via Zoom)
- 15:00–15:30 PT: Board prep (US execs only)
- 19:00–20:30 PT: Board Q&A (SG in late evening; US execs dial back in — we recommend two US execs stay remote for Q&A)

Option B — Virtual (fully asynchronous-friendly)
- Split the product deep-dive across two windows to reduce evening load for SG

Practical asks from our side:
- Confirm list of who must be physically present vs OK to join remotely (we flagged this in the attached XLSX)
- Any hard constraints on the board Q&A window (dates/times to absolutely avoid)
- AV note: for hybrid board Q&A we need a dedicated RTMP link + 2-room audio feed; we can provide our encoder and an AV rider for the venue.

I can run a quick 30m sync with your operations lead to firm up travel/rooms. If May 17 week is primary, we can lock May 18 for the main workshop and May 19 evening for board Q&A.

–Tess
